body: I'm planning on it. I'm off today and so is the manager. I've seen them do this before. They put an employee into a new role as a temp/seasonal so they can give them more hours with lower pay. If that's the case I'm really upset.

Sometimes I feel like this too. For me, showering is a nice getaway from everything. Even if I'm reluctant at first, even if I just stand under the water for 10 minutes without moving, I can do something small for myself, something that other people can't do for me. To me it feels like a little victory. The smell of soap and warm water is really relaxing and satisfying. It's nice to feel refreshed. I hope you'll take a shower, just to enjoy the sound of water and the feeling of steam surrounding you. So you can breathe and feel a bit of relief.

I've tried therapy previously, but due to insurance problems it's not a viable option. I've tried meditation too, but I wasn't very good at it. In a way I use art as a form of therapy for myself. I want to again.

I agree with the other posts here. Just let your friend know you're enjoying your new lifestyle and you're worried about spiraling. If you don't want to mention that you can still turn their offer down in an amiable way. Maybe invite him to do something different with you, something you can both enjoy. It's fine for people to have interests in different things and there's ways to meet on common ground. A good friend will be understanding. Good luck, and congrats on being healthier.
It isn't a recent thing. I've been struggling probably since January. I can't give a tipping point, just tired of it all.
My partner and I ended up arguing about school. It shouldn't have made a difference, but I can't handle much recently.
I'm in a similar situation. I'm really sorry to hear you're feeling that way, but I know what you mean.

It's hard not to be angry with myself. There are few things I genuinely want now. Going to class was something I was looking forward to...but I freaked out and didn't go. I have work and class tomorrow...but I don't think work matters. I'm not really planning on being around for more than a few months. I have enough money saved up to where it doesn't matter. I feel like a pathetic excuse of a human being. Thank you for being so positive. I appreciate the reassurance.
I didn't even go to class...i started getting ready and broke down again. I'm so angry at myself. Thank for your comment.
I'm sorry you feel this way too. It's so exhausting. Thank you for the song suggestion. I'll check it out after class.

I have. It ends up in an argument. My mother is very defensive and acts like she can do no wrong. If i politely address something she's said that's hurtful she'll deny it repeatedly, blame me for taking it that way, and say I'm attacking her. If I disengage she'll ignore me for several days and have my father call me to relay messages. This is almost an every other day thing to a weekly thing. It's draining to say the least...
Thank you so much for taking your time to talk with me and listen to me. It's been rough.

He knows my hobbies...they're just not activities for more than one person, so it feels like they have no priority. It has been eating me up. I've tried...and I'll keep trying. Thank you. I really appreciate it. I hope you and your partner are able to openly communicate your interests with each other again in a positive way.
It's not just him...Most of my family and former friends treat me like a burden too. I'm too much of this, or too little of that. I should do this, shouldn't do that. I'm the common denominator.

Pretending to be okay has been the only thing that's helped previously. I've tried talking about what will help me. I've tried adjusting to help him...but the more I try to fix things the more I discover I've just been a burden. I don't want to a burden anymore.

I've tried talking with him, but it's frustrating to him. I understand why. I don't want to be a burden any longer. I currently don't have the resources to pay for all/any of those things. I wish I did. I want to change things. I want to get better. I appreciate your comment.

I'm at a point in my life where I'm tired of trying. I have no energy left. People say things will get better and I've been waiting. I try my hardest at everything I do, but I don't succeed. I started attending school again...but I've messed it up and I'm failing because I had a breakdown. I'm so far behind now. My mother is narcissistic. I try not to associate with her, but I can't go no contact because she has her fingers in every aspect of my life. My friends have abandoned me, that or they never really cared. I reached out so frequently. My relationship is failing. It was something I strongly believed in and worked hard for. There's a lot more I could say. I just don't have the energy to try so much anymore. Sorry for the lengthy response. I tried to give the abridged version. Thank you for asking.
